messages:
Alex Kim: hey team :wave: quick onboarding question — who owns adding people to Sentry projects and Grafana folders? also need read access to the Datadog infra dashboard.
Maria Chen: welcome Alex! :tada: for access we use the infra-access form: https://go/redwood-access. in the request put:
• tools: Sentry, Grafana (folder: inference), Datadog (dash: infra-overview)
• team: inference-platform
I can fast-track the Grafana folder once the form is submitted.
Olivia Park: for Datadog we need a one-line justification and your org alias. after you file the form ping me and I9ll grant view-only. also tell us if you want Sentry alerts routed to a channel or pager.
Alex Kim: filing now. org alias: inference-platform. route Sentry notify to #inference-oncall for sev2+.
Todd Nguyen: note on Sentry routing — if you want to prototype rules, go to Alerts -> Rules -> New Rule, set condition like "error frequency > 1 in 5m" and action -> Send a notification -> Slack #inference-oncall (or webhook). ping @olivia or @todd to make it prod-safe.
Alex Kim: one more: I can9t see the Grafana "inference" folder in my sidebar.
Maria Chen: grabbed your request and bumped it. I just added Viewer to the inference folder for you. try this link (should work in ~1m): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inference/inference-dashboards
Alex Kim: can see it now, perfect :raised_hands:
Olivia Park: Datadog view-only applied. check Dashboards -> Managed -> infra-overview. If you don9t see a panel, DM me the dashboard id.
Sentry Bot: automated message — membership change: Alex Kim added to project 'inference-service' (role: viewer).
Alex Kim: could you also add me to the deploy-failures alert subscription? want to make sure I get pages during my oncall week.
Todd Nguyen: done — added you to deploy-failures and to the oncall rotation for tests. you9ll get a test alert in ~5m.
Alex Kim: got the test alert, looks good. thanks all!
Maria Chen: if you want a 15m walkthrough of dashboards/alert playbook later this week I can do that. midday works for me.
Alex Kim: midday is great, I9ll DM times. thanks again!
